methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch on 2026-06-14. 7shifts' official pricing page (7shifts.com/pricing) rendered JS-only with no extractable content; prices for 7shifts were taken from two independent aggregators: GetApp and SoftwareAdvice (both corroborating $39.99/$69.99/$149.99/mo flat and a free Comp tier). Homebase annual-discount rate: official site shows $30→$24 monthly (20% off), corroborated by GetApp stating '20% discount'. Sling annual-discount rate: official site states 15% savings. All monthlyUsd values reflect the lowest recurring per-billing-cycle amount (annualized monthly rate where annual billing is the basis). Per-seat products use billingModel=per_seat; per-location flat products use billingModel=flat; quote-only tiers use billingModel=custom with monthlyUsd=null. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null throughout (non-telephony vertical). hipaa/baa set to null unless explicitly stated on the vendor site. bilingual set to null throughout.

vendors.name: When I Work
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page: https://wheniwork.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Three-tier structure (Essentials/Pro/Premium at $2.50/$5.00/$8.00 per user/month) confirmed. Aggregators (GetApp, SoftwareAdvice) show an older two-tier structure; official page is authoritative.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Per user per month. Includes auto-scheduling, templates, multi-week/location scheduling, forecasting, in-app messaging, shift swapping. Annual billing available per official page but discount percentage not published.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per user per month. Adds advanced scheduling rules, permissions, labor sharing, custom forecasting, callout reporting, custom reports, timezone toggling.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Per user per month. Adds API access, webhooks, SAML/SSO on top of Pro.

vendors.name: Deputy
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page: https://www.deputy.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Corroborated by GetApp aggregator page.

plans.name: Lite
plans.notes: Per user per month, excl. taxes. Minimum spend $30 USD/month. Scheduling and time tracking basics.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Per user per month, excl. taxes. Most popular plan. Advanced operations and productivity tools.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per user per month, excl. taxes. Includes Analytics+ and Messaging+ add-ons, priority support, advanced automation and insights.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote only. Contact sales for custom enterprise pricing.

vendors.name: Homebase
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page: https://joinhomebase.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. Per-location flat pricing. Annual discount: official site shows $30→$24/mo (20% off), corroborated by GetApp stating '20% discount'. Corroborated by GetApp aggregator.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Free forever. Limited to 1 location and up to 10 employees. Core scheduling and time tracking.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Per location per month when billed annually ($24/mo); $30/mo billed monthly. Unlimited employees. Scheduling, time tracking, team messaging.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Per location per month when billed annually ($56/mo); $70/mo billed monthly. Unlimited employees. Adds hiring, PTO policies, departments.

plans.name: All-in-One
plans.notes: Per location per month when billed annually ($96/mo); $120/mo billed monthly. Unlimited employees. Full suite including onboarding, performance, and advanced reporting.

vendors.name: Sling
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page: https://getsling.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. Annual discount confirmed at 15% on official page (Premium $2.00→$1.70, Business $4.00→$3.40). Corroborated by GetApp aggregator.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free for up to 30 users. Core scheduling, shift organization, time-off requests, announcements, private messaging.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Per user per month billed annually ($1.70/user); $2.00/user/month billed monthly. Adds time tracking, labor cost management, overtime tracking.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Per user per month billed annually ($3.40/user); $4.00/user/month billed monthly. Adds kiosk time clock, payroll reports, no-shows and sick call-out tracking, PTO management.

vendors.name: Connecteam
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page: https://connecteam.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. Operations Hub plans shown (scheduling-relevant hub). Base prices cover first 30 users; additional users billed per-seat. Small Business plan free for up to 10 users. Annual pricing saves ~18%. Monthly prices listed here are the month-to-month rates. Corroborated by GetApp aggregator.

plans.name: Small Business
plans.notes: Free for life for up to 10 employees. All hubs and features included.

plans.name: Operations Hub Basic
plans.notes: Per month (annual billing) for first 30 users; $0.80/user/month for each additional user. Month-to-month rate is $29/month. Annual saves ~18%. Includes scheduling, time tracking with GPS, payroll integration.

plans.name: Operations Hub Advanced
plans.notes: Per month (annual billing) for first 30 users; $2.50/user/month for each additional user. Month-to-month rate is $49/month. Adds smart groups, geofencing, recurring shifts, timesheet locking.

plans.name: Operations Hub Expert
plans.notes: Per month (annual billing) for first 30 users; $4.20/user/month for each additional user. Month-to-month rate is $99/month. Adds multi-branch management, live GPS breadcrumbs, process automation.

plans.name: Operations Hub Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote only. Includes two-factor authentication, biometric lock, API access, personal account manager, private branded app.

vendors.name: 7shifts

Prices sourced from two independent aggregators: GetApp (https://www.getapp.com/operations-management-software/a/7shifts/pricing/) and SoftwareAdvice (https://www.softwareadvice.com/scheduling/7shifts-profile/), both independently confirming Comp (free), Essentials $39.99/mo, Pro $69.99/mo, Premium $149.99/mo flat per-location pricing.

plans.name: Comp
plans.notes: Free plan. Includes schedule templates, PTO/break/overtime tracking. Targeted at single-location restaurants.

plans.name: Essentials

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Flat per location per month. Advanced budgeting, labor alerts, manager logbook, payroll integration, compliance tools. Official site JS-blocked; price from two aggregators.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Flat per location per month. Task management, advanced reporting, full payroll integration. Official site JS-blocked; price from two aggregators.
